name: cherqain-js-tests
description: Test harnesses only: Vitest + jsdom for unit tests, Playwright + Chromium for the browser matrix (layout, enforced CSP, blob-PDF rendering — none of which jsdom can observe). The app itself ships no npm build step: runtime third-party JS stays vendored under static/js/vendor/ (see CLAUDE.md — never load runtime JS from a CDN or node_modules).
